relationship_to_human_design.rule: separate study; does not amend, satisfy, replace, or pool with the frozen human study

question: Does the retained FC audit packet improve issue detection and packet-only continuation for attributed GPT-5.6 Sol review task contexts relative to matched public source evidence alone?

reviewer_policy.session_policy: fresh ephemeral task context for every fixture-role observation
reviewer_policy.tool_policy: rooted local packet supplied in prompt; read-only empty working directory; no network, repository, browser, memory, plugin, app, image, computer-use, goal, workspace-dependency, or multi-agent capability
reviewer_policy.identity_policy: unique agent task-context id; no human impersonation; the model does not claim custody of the runner's OAuth session
reviewer_policy.quality_rule: actor class is provenance, not a quality rank

shared_dependencies: OpenAI provider and GPT-5.6 Sol model family
Codex CLI 0.145.0 and its base instructions
one evaluation runner and one output schema per role
the same public fixture evidence and frozen ground truth
the same operator account and OAuth billing boundary

sample.stopping_rule: run every one of the 60 predeclared task contexts once; retain failures and do not replace, retry, add, remove, or stop based on outcomes

matched_input_rule.shared: condition packet, retained public evidence, and exact changed source bytes at the frozen head
matched_input_rule.treatment_only: retained FC audit core and observation named by the frozen condition packet
matched_input_rule.source_materialization: exact public GitHub bytes verified against the retained Git blob id before bundling
matched_input_rule.receiver_addition: the exact sender output and its raw SHA-256

H2: input, output, and reasoning token use
H5: input, output, and reasoning token use

analysis.time_estimator: fixture-fixed-effect treatment coefficient on log elapsed seconds, exponentiated
analysis.uncertainty: descriptive dyad-cluster bootstrap with 10000 deterministic resamples; no population claim
analysis.quality: exact retained counts and denominators before percentages
analysis.support_threshold: treatment point ratio <= 0.80, no lower consequential sensitivity or classification accuracy, no added false positive or authority violation

public_custody.rule: all prompts, public inputs, model outputs, timing, and usage records are public evaluation artifacts
exclusions: local filesystem paths outside the repository

nonclaims: not a probability sample or general model benchmark
not evidence that agent review is better or worse than human review
not Formal Conjectures acceptance, merge, or maintainer review
not a Vela Verification or Decision
